messages.subject: Version 0.52 - rhcounter more robust
parts:
Hello,

In versions before 0.52 (latest), a "," in the group or subgroup of
rhcounter would upset Hadoop to the point the job would fail.

This version fixes this.

If you don't want to upgrade, a workaround is not to use "," in the
first two parameters of rhcounter. For details about rhcounter see [1]
and [2]

Download site: http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/#sec-5

Regards
Saptarshi

[1] http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/doc/html/rhmr.html#counter
[2] From http://www.umiacs.umd.edu/~jimmylin/cloud9/docs/content/counters.html

"
Built-In Counters

Counters are lightweight objects in Hadoop that allow you to keep track of
system progress in both the map and reduce stages of processing. By
default, Hadoop defines a number of standard counters in "groups";
these show up in the jobtracker Webapp, giving you information such as
"Map input records", "Map output records", etc.
"
